fusions.name: Unseen Cut
fusions.desc: Strikes an enemy at or below 25% health for 22 dark damage and consumes every affliction on it, adding 1.3 times their remaining damage to the hit. Until something has bled, it has 50% more critical chance.

fusions.name: Nicking Flick
fusions.desc: Flicks a blade that deals 4 slashing damage, up to 1.6 times that at maximum range, and leaves the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds. You heal for 15% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Hidden Edge
fusions.desc: Increases your critical hit chance by 30% for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Quiet Kill
fusions.desc: When you kill something, your next strike gains 30% critical hit chance. Once every 8 seconds.
